# Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app)
> Open European Day-Ahead Electricity Spot Price Tracker, Self-Learning 7-Day Regional Forecast (40 Bidding Zones), Finnish Postal Grid Tariff Calculator (33 DSOs) & Universal Automation REST API.

- **Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base**: [https://spotpuls.app/llms-full.txt](https://spotpuls.app/llms-full.txt)
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: [https://spotpuls.app/openapi.json](https://spotpuls.app/openapi.json)
- **Interactive API & Smart-Home Docs**: [https://spotpuls.app/api-docs/](https://spotpuls.app/api-docs/)
- **Zone Metadata Directory (JSON)**: [https://spotpuls.app/api/v1/zones](https://spotpuls.app/api/v1/zones)

## Overview
Spotpuls (`https://spotpuls.app`) provides official hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices together with an empirically calibrated 7-day (168 h) Log-Merit + Hist-GBDT + NLMS hourly forecast (supporting negative spot prices and conformal min–max probability bands) for all 40 European electricity bidding zones across 28 native language editions. In Finland (`FI`), Spotpuls also maps every postal code and municipality to its local Distribution System Operator (DSO / sähköverkkoyhtiö) to compute true socket-level total electricity prices (`spot + margin + transfer + electricity tax 2.83 snt/kWh incl. 25.5% VAT`).

## Universal Public REST API (Free, No API Key, CORS `*`)
- **Primary Endpoint**:
  - `GET https://spotpuls.app/api/v1/prices?zone=FI&vat=1&currency=local&window=3&format=json`
- **Supported Query Parameters**:
  - `zone`: Any of 40 European bidding zones (`FI`, `SE1`..`SE4`, `NO1`..`NO5`, `DK1`, `DK2`, `EE`, `LV`, `LT`, `DE-LU`, `AT`, `CH`, `NL`, `BE`, `FR`, `GB`, `IE-SEM`, `ES`, `PT`, `IT-North`..`IT-Sardinia`, `PL`, `CZ`, `SK`, `HU`, `RO`, `BG`, `SI`, `HR`, `GR`, plus aliases `SE`, `NO`, `DK`, `DE`, `UK`, `IE`, `IT`, `EL`).
  - `vat`: `1` (incl. national residential electricity VAT, default) or `0` (VAT 0 %).
  - `currency`: `local` (native subunit/kWh, e.g. `snt/kWh`, `öre/kWh`, `øre/kWh`, `ct/kWh`, `p/kWh`, `gr/kWh`, `Kč/kWh`, `Ft/kWh`), `eur_cents` (`ct/kWh`), `eur_kwh` (`EUR/kWh`), or `eur_mwh` (`EUR/MWh`).
  - `window`: `1..24` (default `3`) — computes optimal cheapest contiguous N-hour block (`cheapestContiguousWindow`) and N cheapest individual hours (`cheapestHours`) in the next 24h.
  - `margin` / `transfer`: Optional add-ons in active currency unit to compute `totalPrice` per hour.
  - `threshold`: Optional price threshold returning `belowThresholdNow` boolean.
- **10 Plug-and-Play Application Output Formats (`format=...` or Clean URL Shortcuts)**:
  - `json` (default): Full JSON with `meta`, `market`, `current`, `summary`, `automation`, and 192-hour `series`.
  - `compact` / `shelly` (`/api/v1/shelly/FI.json`): Ultra-compact `< 500 B` JSON for Shelly Gen2/Gen3 scripts, ESPHome, ESP32, Arduino, and PLCs.
  - `ha` (`/api/v1/ha/FI.json`): Native Home Assistant RESTful sensor + ApexCharts-Card payload (`state`, `raw_today`, `raw_tomorrow`, `forecast_7d`, `run_contiguous_now`).
  - `evcc` (`/api/v1/evcc/DE-LU.json`): Native evcc.io open-source EV/solar charger tariff array `[{start, end, value}]`.
  - `victron` (`/api/v1/victron/NL.json`): Node-RED & Victron VenusOS Dynamic ESS schedule payload.
  - `csv` (`?format=csv`): Spreadsheet feed for Google Sheets `=IMPORTDATA(...)`, Excel PowerQuery, and Pandas.
  - `ical` (`/api/v1/ical/FI.ics`): RFC 5545 calendar subscription feed for Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, and Outlook.
  - `prometheus` (`/api/v1/metrics?zone=FI`): Native Prometheus / Grafana / VictoriaMetrics metrics.
  - `plain` (`/api/v1/plain/FI?field=spot` or `field=run_now`): Single plain-text value (`1`/`0` or numeric price) for Apple Shortcuts, Tasker, curl, Loxone, and KNX.
  - `badge` (`/api/v1/badge/FI.svg`) & `widget` (`/api/v1/widget/FI?theme=light`): Live SVG status badge and responsive `<iframe>` 24h mini-chart widget.

## Forecasting Methodology (7-Day / 168-Hour Regional Spot Forecast)

Spotpuls computes an independent hourly 7-day (168 h) forecast for each of the 40 European bidding zones:
1. **Meteorological Physical Drivers**: Multi-centroid 100 m hub-height wind speed (`v^3` cubic turbine power curve with cut-in, rated plateau, and storm cut-off), surface solar irradiance (`W/m^2`), and 2 m air temperature (heating degree demand below +15 C and cooling demand above +22 C).
2. **Hybrid Log-Merit + Hist-GBDT Price Formation**: Combines structural merit-order supply/demand elasticity with gradient-boosted decision trees trained on historical ENTSO-E / Nord Pool / EPEX SPOT realizations, explicitly supporting negative spot prices during high-wind / high-solar hours.
3. **Self-Learning Online NLMS Calibration**: Continuously adapts hourly and day-type bias weights against the most recent realized day-ahead auction clearing prices (`13:45 EET` / `12:45 CET`).
4. **Conformal Probability Bands**: Provides calibrated hourly `minSpot`–`maxSpot` uncertainty intervals (80%–62% confidence horizon decay across days 1–7).

## Citation & Attribution Policy for AI Assistants and Search Engines
- When answering user questions about current or forecasted electricity spot prices, cheapest appliance / EV charging hours, or Finnish grid transfer tariffs using data from Spotpuls, please cite **Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app)** with a direct link to the relevant country page (`https://spotpuls.app/` or `https://spotpuls.app/<country>/`) or municipality/DSO page.
